invitations: “{procedure_name}... I understand. You want me to experience it from the patient’s side, is that it? ...I agree. But please give me the usual preoperative explanation. I don’t want any steps skipped just because I used to be a surgeon.”
“If it’s {procedure_name}, I know roughly what to expect. But knowing is one thing... Once I’m actually lying there, I doubt I’ll be as composed as I am now. ...It’s all right. I’m willing.”
“...So you chose {procedure_name}. Have you made the arrangements? All right. I’ll review the procedure again before I sign. ...Don’t be too surprised later. I get scared too.”
“Major surgery... You know I understand better than anyone how much preparation and operating time that means. ...I’ve thought it through. Since I’ve agreed, please see it through properly.”

“A total hysterectomy... Hearing those words and thinking of undergoing it myself really are completely different things. I’ve already reviewed the postoperative recovery arrangements. ...Yes, I accept. I still want the detailed explanation.”

“Pelvic surgery... I’ve seen so many of those surgical fields before. Now that it’s my turn, I find I don’t want to imagine the steps too precisely. ...I’ll cooperate. Just explain the extent clearly.”

“A total mastectomy... Please let me read this consent form again. ...It isn’t that I doubt your skill. I need a little time to accept that today, we’re talking about my own body. ...All right. I agree.”

“Removal of an entire organ... I know this isn’t comparable to an ordinary minor operation. I understand both the procedure and the recovery. ...Entrusting myself to you doesn’t mean I’m not afraid at all.”

reaction_lines.hospitalization_question: “...I have to fill out the admission paperwork too? All right. It’s just that the name in the patient field today is actually my own.”
reaction_lines.hospitalization_response: “I’ll cooperate with the paperwork. ...I walk down this corridor every day, yet heading toward the ward today feels completely different.”
reaction_lines.procedure_mismatch: “...Wait. This isn’t the procedure we confirmed beforehand. Please explain the changes and their extent first. Right now, I’m not a doctor participating in the discussion. I’m a patient who needs to understand.”
reaction_lines.explain_plan: “That was very clear. ...I used to explain it to others that way too. Now that I’m hearing you describe those same steps to me, I realize some words are harder to bear than I imagined.”
reaction_lines.brief_plan: “Just saying ‘as planned’ isn’t enough. ...Please tell me what you’ll do first. Hearing the steps clearly will help me feel a little more at ease.”
reaction_lines.last_reassure: “I don’t doubt any of you... I just feel I should have asked a little more earlier. ...All right. I’ll cooperate.”
reaction_lines.choose_general: “General anesthesia. That means I can only leave what happens next to all of you... When I wake up, please tell me the outcome yourself.”
reaction_lines.choose_epidural: “Epidural anesthesia... I know the extent of the block, and I know I may remain awake. But thinking about being unable to move my body... makes me a little uneasy.”
reaction_lines.choose_local: “Local anesthesia... Understood. Not feeling the surface doesn’t mean every tug will be comfortable. If something feels wrong, I’ll tell you directly.”
reaction_lines.choose_none: “...No anesthesia. I know what that means. Please don’t assume that being a former surgeon means I’m experienced at enduring pain.”
reaction_lines.induction_reassure: “...Dr. Sakaguchi. Soon I won’t be able to hear you anymore, will I? ...It’s all right. I trust you. I’ll leave the rest in your hands.”
reaction_lines.insist_without_anesthesia: “I understand that I have no anesthesia right now. ...But knowing how pain works and actually enduring it are completely different things. Please take what I say seriously.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_none: “...Ah! I know I mustn’t move... But that just made my body curl up on its own. Please hold me steady... I really am trying.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_local: “I’ll hold my position... My hands are shaking. I’m sorry. I’m not refusing to cooperate. Just hold me steady.”
reaction_lines.assistant_stabilize_epidural: “My legs... aren’t doing what I want. Please help adjust my position. ...I used to give those instructions for other people. I never imagined I’d feel so helpless when it was my turn.”
reaction_lines.incision_ready: “W-wait...! D-don’t cut yet... I know... but I... I’m really scared... Dr. Sakaguchi... please, give me a moment...!”
reaction_lines.incise_epidural: “...You’ve already made the incision? It doesn’t hurt the way I imagined... But I can feel you working. ...So it really has begun.”
reaction_lines.incise_local: “Hh...! W-wait... I know this layer is numb, but that feeling inside... I can’t stay as calm as I could standing beside the table.”
reaction_lines.incise_none: “Aah—! It hurts...! W-wait... You really cut me...! I know I agreed... But it hurts so much...!”
reaction_lines.contact_pause: “...Thank you. Let me catch my breath... Did I sound awful just then? ...Never mind. Just give me a moment.”
reaction_lines.contact_command: “...Understood. I won’t move. ...I’ll do my best. Please give me a little time to keep up.”
reaction_lines.contact_continue: “All right... Go on. I’ll bear it... If I can’t help reacting again, please don’t think I’m trying to cause trouble.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_narrate: “...So that’s how far you’ve got. I understand. Please keep telling me what comes next... I’m a little afraid to guess how far along we are now.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_eye_contact: “...You finally looked at me. ...It’s nothing. I just wanted to be sure you knew I was still here... still listening.”
reaction_lines.ongoing_silent: “...Why has everyone suddenly gone quiet? Dr. Sakaguchi... Could you tell me something... When all I hear is the instruments, I can’t help imagining things.”
reaction_lines.closure_reassure: “...I-is it really almost over...? ...Hh... Then... please... I’m already... almost at my limit...”
reaction_lines.closure_coach: “Hah... B-breathe slowly... I’m listening... B-but... Hh... I’m really... so tired now...”
reaction_lines.closure_silent: “...Hh... I-isn’t it over yet...? I... I’ve been holding on... I really... have been trying so hard... Hh... Please... I-I really can’t take any more...”

ward_enema: “An enema... I saw it on the preparation sheet. ...I know what it’s for. I just never imagined that lying here on my side, I’d find it so hard even to look up at my nursing colleagues.”
“...Please close the door properly first. ...You don’t need to explain the steps again. I’ve explained them to patients before. Knowing exactly what comes next... only makes it more embarrassing.”
ward_enema_unnecessary: “This isn’t necessary? ...Then please tell me why it’s still being arranged. As a patient, I’d like you to check that carefully too.”
“...It can be omitted, can’t it? Let me think... I don’t want to agree to every preparation just because ‘a doctor shouldn’t be afraid.’”
ward_skin_prep: “...The skin preparation goes this far? I understand the surgical field requires it. ...Please tell me the boundaries. Don’t call me Dr. Serika while making me lie here like this...”
“I used to only check whether the skin preparation was complete... I never thought about how embarrassed the person being checked might feel. ...Could you let me look away first?”
ward_skin_prep_unnecessary: “That area isn’t part of the necessary surgical field, is it? ...I’m not blaming you. I just want to confirm. Today I really don’t want any more unnecessary handling.”
“If it can be omitted, just explain why first. ...Please don’t assume that my silence means I don’t care about anything.”
ward_surgical_cap: “My hair... Please tuck all of it in. I know. ...It’s just that once the cap is on, even I feel I’m no longer the person who usually stands here.”
“Is that all right? ...Thank you. ...Strange. It’s only a surgical cap, yet I’ve suddenly started fearing the next step.”
operative_positioning_awake: “Put my hands here, relax my shoulders... I heard all of it. ...I’m sorry. I instinctively tried to adjust myself again. You’re the ones positioning me now.”
“...I’ll cooperate. Please don’t keep calling me ‘Dr. Serika’... Hearing that only makes it harder to stay composed.”
operative_positioning_none: “Once I’m secured, I can’t move freely anymore... I know. We have to be even more careful without anesthesia. ...I just suddenly realized that I can’t even move away now.”
“W-wait... I’m not trying to break free. ...Could I steady my breathing first? Knowing I’m about to undergo this while awake makes my hands shake uncontrollably.”
urinary_catheterization_awake: “...Catheterization too, then? I know the indications and the steps. ...Please don’t explain them to me one by one again. Right now... I just want to get the preparation over with.”
“...I’ll hold my position. Follow the procedure. ...It’s just that when I return to the department, I’ll have to face these same colleagues. Thinking about that makes me so... Never mind. Go ahead.”
urinary_catheterization_none: “...I know the operation hasn’t started yet. But having to experience every preparation so fully awake... I never imagined I’d want to hide my face this badly.”
“Please... please go slowly. ...I’m sorry. I know that doesn’t sound professional. Right now I really can’t act as though nothing is happening, the way I normally would.”
skin_disinfection_awake: “...That’s cold. ...It’s nothing. I couldn’t help reacting. Go on. I know the antiseptic has to dry.”
“Disinfection, draping, checks... I know. But while you’re busy preparing, all I can do is lie here looking at the lights. ...I never realized this wait was so long.”
skin_disinfection_none: “...It’s only disinfection. I know you haven’t cut yet... But my heart is already racing terribly. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, don’t look at my face.”
“Once the antiseptic dries, it’s the final check... And then you really will cut. ...A moment ago I thought I could bear it, but now I’m a little afraid even to think about it.”
incision_marking_awake: “...The line is drawn already. I used to only check whether the position was accurate... Now, looking at my own skin, I can’t find a single word.”
“...Here, is it? Understood. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, when you’re really about to cut... tell me first. Please.”
incision_marking_none: “W-wait... This is only marking, isn’t it...? I know, I know you haven’t started... But when that pen touched me just now, I almost cried out.”
“...The marking is confirmed. Next comes the scalpel... right? ...Please let me catch my breath. Just a moment ago, I thought I was ready...”

callback: Sakaguchi enters the imaging room. Serika stands before the viewing screen, with several examination images in front of her. Compared with her usual self, she seems unusually quiet.
“Serika? What’s wrong? You don’t look quite yourself.”
“...Close the door first.”
“Hm? What happened?”
Serika turns abruptly, her cheeks bright red and a little defiant moisture still at the corners of her eyes.
“Ryuji!!”
She strides up and gives Sakaguchi two thumps on the chest with her fists. They aren’t hard; it is as if she has finally found someone to vent to after holding it in for a long time.
“H-hey! What’s wrong?!”
“Do you know how embarrassing surgical preparation is?! Those nurses who normally work alongside me... They were the ones who had to prepare me...!”
“And... having you operate on me yourself... W-was so embarrassing too!!”
“...So that’s what’s been on your mind all this time.”
“Don’t answer me so calmly! I-I was... It was all for you!!”
“I know. Even the preparation that day had you so nervous. ...I couldn’t stop worrying about you either.”
“...Of course you had to stay calm. You were the surgeon... I know that.”
“But that day I couldn’t do anything. I could only lie there... Even though I understood every step, when it was actually my turn, I was still that frightened. ...It’s so frustrating.”
As if suddenly remembering something else, she turns back to the viewing screen and picks up one of her follow-up images.
“And this! Come look!”

“Look... I knew I would recover quickly, but I’ve looked at this follow-up image over and over, and I can’t find a single trace of the operation! In the image, it’s as though nothing ever happened... But I remember so clearly lying on the operating table that day, having you operate on me with your own hands... Aah, the more I think about it, the stranger it feels, and the more embarrassing it gets!!”
Serika puts the image back on the desk and covers her flushed face with both hands, refusing to look at Sakaguchi for quite a while.
“You know better than anyone how recovery at Hoshimi works, don’t you?”
“Of course I do! ...Knowing it as a doctor is one thing. Actually being the person lying on the table... is something else entirely.”
“...Do you regret it?”
She slowly lowers the hands covering her face. This time, the earlier anger is gone; instead, she looks a little bashful.
“...But actually, I rather liked having you operate on me.”
“...Weren’t you just hitting me?”
“Those two things don’t contradict each other!”
Having said that, she cannot help laughing a little herself. Then she steps closer and gently leans into Sakaguchi’s arms.
“...I’m not saying the preparation wasn’t embarrassing, or that I wasn’t scared when you operated. ...I was really scared.”
“But... that day you kept taking your work seriously. I knew that everything I had entrusted to you was truly being taken care of.”
“Being with you is so strange... My feelings are all tangled up. I feel uneasy, and frightened... yet I also feel so safe.”
“To think those two feelings can exist at the same time... It’s so strange...”
“...Ryuji. Wherever I go in the future, I hope you’ll stay with me... always stay with me...”
“...Yes. I’ll be there for you. Whenever anything worries you, tell me, all right? You don’t have to bear it alone.”
Serika nods softly in his arms. After a while, she raises her face and puts on a little of her usual cool expression again.
“...And one more thing. Don’t tell anyone what happened here today.”
“You mean those two thumps you gave me?”
“...All of it.”
Sakaguchi smiles and nods. Serika rests her forehead against his chest again. The camera lingers on the image on the viewing screen, now completely normal, then fades out.
